source: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Department of Agricultural Extension, in collaboration with the Siem Reap Provincial Department of Agriculture and an economic development program, trifold brochure "វិធីដាំខ្នុរ" (How to Plant Jackfruit) / "បទពិសោធន៍ជោគជ័យ ក្នុងការដាំខ្នុរ របស់កសិករគំរូ" (Successful Experience in Growing Jackfruit of a Model Farmer), Siem Reap, 2013
text:
About 1 month after planting, remove the wrapping/cover placed around the young tree.

During the rainy season, protect the young tree from waterlogging or flooding around its roots.

At the start of the dry season, apply fertilizer around the base of the tree: use NPK 15-15-15 fertilizer (three applications), mixed with soil and organic material such as cow or chicken manure and chopped banana stem or rice straw, and bury this mixture in the soil, forming it into a mound or ridge around the base of the tree.

If the jackfruit seedling is being eaten by insects, apply an insecticide such as S85 Carbaryl, spraying it thoroughly onto the leaves and stem.
